note: TL is a hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway: all assumptions at full strength from 1 January 2027, combining best observed attributes of different buildings and places; not a proposal or a feasible pathway (potentials hierarchy: theoretical > technical > realisable). TL1 No vacancy (vacancy 0, 2026 overbuild absorbed), TL2 No extra space (size = household size × occupant load factor), TL3 Minimum space per person (the smallest occupant load factor of the case studies, 19.7 m² per person, for every typology), TL4 Best-practice materials (each typology's best case-study A1–A3), TL5 Lowest-carbon soils (lowest soil order), TL6 Urban infill (65% of non-replacement floor area on developed land, no soil carbon loss; Auckland Council 2021); the adopted decarbonisation applies. In its zero-building years (released vacant stock used, banking rule) every band is zero.
